verdict.rationale: Capacities documents itself as offline-first: you can work offline and changes sync when you reconnect, and search works offline on all devices. However, notes do not live in user-owned local files. Readability without the app comes only through Markdown + CSV exports (front matter, human- and machine-readable), which can be scheduled automatically. Missing for 10: notes stored natively as user-owned local files or an openly readable local store, evidence that every feature works fully offline (AI and integrations unaddressed), and independent hands-on corroboration of offline behavior.
